findings.finding: The only admitted command sequence is exact com.MobileTicket USER 0 LIST, PATHS, MAIN/LAUNCHER RESOLVE, PATHS, LIST. Context checks the next exact argv and then calls the original held Flow.command observation method with mutation=False. There is no launch, install, instrumentation or command retry path in this candidate.

Current UID and version are parsed from a single exact package row. UID is also checked against the externally pinned Main activation. Version 275 is recorded only as a historical comparison. One to sixteen current APK paths are accepted only beneath one syntactically exact com.MobileTicket installation directory with exactly one base.apk. A changed activation UID is a fail-closed rejection, not an invitation to replace that historical authority.

Every APK FD is registered for finally cleanup before its shape is checked. Regular-file, owner, mode, nlink, per-file/aggregate bounds and streaming deadline gates remain. Held identity is checked after hashing and again after actual package re-reads; reopening the name must recover the same identity. APK contents and unrelated package inventory are not exported.

Resolver output is bounded and must contain exactly one component for the same package. No fallback is selected. The result explicitly says launch_performed=false and later_launch_requires_new_current_binding=true; this metadata observation cannot authorize a later stale launch.

An entry/command error aborts subsequent business reads. Context independently attempts entry release and the post-command guard, preserving the first error with secondary notes. The outer finally closes held APK FDs, closes the target, checks Main, and closes only the acquired action-lock FD; cleanup errors force ok=false without replacing a prior error.

The stage creates one fresh private root and source, with create-only claims. Its exact request binds the entire stdin packet and embedded stage. A successful stage requires the original worker return code, durable result nonce/package/source pin and ok=true, followed by unchanged source/Main gates. Collection success is not whole-App readiness or signer certification.
